name: ru.vhrgames.sdk
description: Mandatory VHR Games SDK for Unity 6 WebGL titles. Provides player profile + name resolution, friends, player stats/progression, achievements, game sessions, economy (game catalog items, inventory, purchases confirmed by the player in the VHR platform window; no in-game top-up, spend or grant), in-game ads (interstitial/rewarded via the VHR host page, Yandex Advertising Network), leaderboard, tournaments, lobby/matchmaking + relay multiplayer, server matchmaking (UDP, domain/uuid) and session services that talk to the VHR backend, plus a build marker handshake (vhr-sdk.json) that the backend validates on upload, and Unity Editor testing of every API against the real backend with a sandbox key (VHR menu: Editor testing and Game catalog windows). Builds without this SDK are rejected on confirm-upload.

samples.description: Minimal MonoBehaviour shop: init, balance, catalog items, purchase confirmed by the player, owned items and the top-up button.

_vhr_install_note: R3 and VContainer are NOT bundled. Add the OpenUPM scoped registry (https://package.openupm.com) with scopes com.cysharp.r3 and jp.hadashikick.vcontainer, then install 'R3' (com.cysharp.r3) and 'VContainer' (jp.hadashikick.vcontainer) via Package Manager. R3 additionally requires the NuGet 'System.Reactive' / 'R3' core DLLs via NuGetForUnity or the unitypackage from the R3 repo. See README.md > Installation.
